name: Dev-via-test first-pass Lisa failed → stamp agent.run.outcome=failed (run-anchor)
description:
ADR-053 Phase 4a′ — dev-via-test run-failed mapping, anchor branch 1 of 2 (first-pass Lisa). Fires when a FIRST-PASS planner (dev-via-test-plan spawned by rule 01, run_scope=new) terminates with an involuntary failure (agent.loop.outcome in [failed, truncated]) before emitting decide(planned). Stamps agent.run.outcome=failed on the RUN entity so agent-run/04 transitions executing→failed; otherwise a failed planner has no in-arc recovery and the run hangs `executing`.

ANCHOR FENCE (lineage.run-loop-entity-id length_eq 0): first-pass Lisa carries agent.run.entity_id (framework-stamped from RunID at the run_scope=new spawn) but NO lineage.run-loop-entity-id — rule 02 only re-sources run-loop-entity-id ONTO THE DOWNSTREAM CBG at Lisa's terminal, not back onto Lisa. A RE-PLAN Lisa (spawned from the run entity by rule 02d) carries lineage.run-loop-entity-id but NOT agent.run.entity_id, and the dev-via-test-plan role token matches BOTH passes — so the lineage fence is what splits them. This is the exact same first-pass/re-plan anchor split as dev-via-test 02 vs 02g. The re-plan Lisa + CBG branch is the sibling rule 10 (length_gt 0).

Companion to dev-via-test/08-loop-failed-pause (operator chain.paused.marker, untouched). dev-via-test-execute (Ralph) stays EXCLUDED from both — a Ralph loop-failure routes through rule 04b + rule 05 to a coordinator→ask_user recovery (the user decides), so the run stays `executing` by design; it must NOT fail here.
